data.label: Italian Innovators Initiative
data.title: Scaling the
data.description: A non-profit that connects Italian founders, researchers and professionals with New York's tech companies, investors and universities.

items.title: Research
items.description: We publish research on the New York market and share it with members.

items.title: Institutions
items.description: We work with the Italian Consulate General in New York and run programs for Italian institutions visiting the city.

items.title: Community
items.description: Regular events where Italian innovators in New York meet each other.

items.title: Charter members
items.description: Senior leaders, invited to join, who advise on our programs and mentor members.
